info.emptyText: Pick a .gm1–.gm8 or .cgm file from the Games folder of Heroes 3, or drop it onto the window. The file never leaves your computer, all the magic happens right in your browser.
info.warning: Health warning: excessive editing blocks the development of your logic and thinking, and kills your interest in the game itself.

problem.title: Fix this first:
joke.spellScroll: Can't you read? It says right there in plain English: NOT RECOMMENDED, so don't poke it! =) And if you're itching that badly for magic, just set the spells themselves.
joke.placeholderCreature: Units with these numbers do not exist. You ask why? Because New World Computing forgot to put them into the game, and I opened up these holes so everyone could see them. So you can look, but you can't touch. =)
joke.notRecommended: Not recommended: the game may glitch with this one in the backpack.

welcome.title: Welcome to Heroes III SaveEditor {version}!
welcome.greeting: Hail, hero! You've landed in the Heroes 3 save editor.
welcome.warning: Straight talk first: don't use this thing to beat the game. The editor is for checking and testing your own maps and strategies, not for conjuring a hundred Archangels by day three.
welcome.reminder: Fair warning: cheats and boosts only spoil a magnificent game. Pump up your gold and you'll lose the best part: that moment when you scrape your way out of a hopeless match.
